name: qBittorrent
description: BitTorrent client with a web UI

paths.name: Config
paths.description: qBittorrent's settings, torrent list and resume data.

paths.name: Downloads
paths.description: Where downloads are saved: /mnt/cache/downloads on your MOS.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: qBittorrent web UI, published on host as 6805

ports.name: Port 6806
ports.description: BitTorrent connections from other peers (TCP and UDP), published on host as 6806

ports.name: Port 6806
ports.description: BitTorrent connections from other peers (TCP and UDP), published on host as 6806

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: WEBUI_PORT
variables.description: The web UI port inside the container. It must stay the same as the published port (6805), or the page refuses to sign in.

variables.name: TORRENTING_PORT
variables.description: The port other peers connect to (TCP and UDP). It must stay the same as the published port (6806). Forward it on your router for faster downloads.
